{{Quote|You, there! Why have you fallen out of line? Didn't you hear the announcement? All troops in this sector have been ordered to B Dock, now.|Imperial officer|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 80">[[Star Wars (1977) 80|''Star Wars'' (1977) 80]]</ref>}}
'''B Dock''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Dennaskar]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] came to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] in search of [[Tay Vanis]], they were nearly caught by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. However, the stormtroopers were called away to report to the B Dock.
